name: Prophets of Pop
description: You meet a musician in Natlan named Milu Nui, but he appears to have encountered some trouble...

steps.description: Teach those troublemaking tribespeople a lesson

dialogs.content: Oh no, oh no! My pop music masterpiece is about to be consumed! Devoured!
Had I known this would happen, I'd have asked — no, begged — Pakaa to put it in the children's section...
What's going on?
#You're... Wait, you're {NICKNAME}! Wonderful! You're here!
I have a commission for you — one of utmost importance! Natlan's... no, the future of pop music the world over is in your hands! Please, you must rescue it!
O—One moment, take your time!
Please, save my record! If not, it shall be eaten by those little Koholasaurs... or wrecked by those tone-deaf thugs!
Oh? Is it that obvious I can sing?
Huh? Um... Well... I'm glad you have the talent, and we could certainly work together in the future. But for now...
Alright, Lillo. See those fellows there? They're our target for the day. Ready?
I was born ready.
Still busy with the record?
Hey there. Fancy running into you! And yes, we are putting the materials together for the new song.
After the previous incident, I talked over a few issues regarding the record with Lillo. Got some ideas from that, too.
You exaggerate. I merely suggested that you change methodologies, or find other materials with which to compose your music.
Some of the music I've heard back in the tribe even incorporates the sound of clashing weapons, the cries of battle, and the sounds of running footsteps.
Songs made like that are very popular, and they spread fast... I think that's what you mean, Mr. Milu Nui, when you talk about "pop."
Precisely! That's why we've been seeking warriors out to see how they fight.
So, have you two found your source of inspiration?
Yes indeed! It's none other than those people up ahead. We heard from the tribe that they've been seeking opponents out here, and that they're pretty tough customers...
Ahem. Simply put, this bunch is always causing trouble outside. They just go up to people on the road and ask them if they want to spar.
And if you lose, you'll be forced to give them something, as the stakes of the match.
Some of my musician friends have been robbed by them too... Such scoundrels!
Indeed, the tribespeople have had it up to here with their nonsense. They want someone to teach them a lesson.
Sure sounds like a pretty strange bunch...
Ah, who knows what's going through their heads? To be honest, I've never understood how people like them think.
If you're willing, go teach them a lesson alongside Lillo, would you?
I've witnessed your skills before. Another demonstration will prove to be a great inspiration, I'm sure of it!
But please! If you see that they have any record with them, be sure not to damage it!
Otherwise, my musician friends would faint again, right on the spot...
Don't worry. Just watch closely.
Haha, very nice! With your help, I've all but composed the best song ever to be written!
I'll show you what I've got.
Gathering materials, are we?
Ah... Looks like these boxes were broken... and the record atop them was...
He must be leading us over that way. *sigh* Where did he learn all this nonsense from?
You're the ones Mr. Milu Nui asked to pick up the record, right? I've seen you talking to him, so I can guess your purpose.
We're all People of the Springs. That guy... He used to be an alright sort. No clue where he's been getting all these bad habits lately.
Ah yes, I forgot to introduce myself. You can call me Lillo — and again, I apologize for my... compatriot's behavior.
...Bah. I'm no good at formal conversation. If we were back with the tribe, I'd have treated you to a drink of water at least.
Eh, I'm an adventurer. I'm used to this...
Huh, that so? ...Y'know what, judging by your appearance, and how you acquitted yourself back there, you do seem to be an experienced adventurer.
...Anyway. Never mind that for now. Let's clean this place up first. I'll collect the fragments of the record.
Then I'll go with you to see Mr. Milu Nui. I must apologize to him in person.
You've worked with people from Liyue before?
That's right. I was once hired by a gentleman from Liyue. Accompanied him into the mountains to prospect for ore veins.
I learned a lot from working with him — and when he left, he even gave me a name in his nation's style, "Yiyang."
According to him, it means "to soar elegantly in the air." Not that I really understand where he got that, though...
A brilliant battle, you two! I must say, you left quite the impression!
Not only were you strong, but rhythmic. Why, you commanded that battle as a conductor would, baton in hand!
Most importantly... The record is pretty much intact! Thanks to you, my friends can finally have a good night's sleep.
Hmm... Wait, rhythm...? That's right! That's it! This is the rhythm I'm looking for!
We could use it as the basis of the melody... No, I'll need an instrument with a lower sound profile...
Anyway, these are for you, so please, take them! Come on, Lillo, let's head back to the tribe. I've got the inspiration I need!
Agh, I shall have to write down all these rhythms, but where do I... Right, my clothes! I'll just pen 'em down here!
Ah, my record! Thank goodness, it's undamaged...
I must apologize, Mr Milu Nui. My companion was the one who stole the record. Please accept my apologies on his behalf.
The record is fine, and that's what matters.
Right you are, right you are indeed. This one was the original record, too... Had it been damaged, I'd have found the nearest cliff to leap off of.
...And Lillo, brother, don't hang your head. The record's fine, so there's no point being petty about all this.
Just answer one of my questions, and we'll call us even.
Ask away. I will give you my best answer.
When you were listening to my record, did you think it was good?
Not the "it'll be a hit amongst children and baby Saurians" sort of "good," but rather... in the "pop" sense, of having that pop spirit!
Do you get what I mean? Did you get that feeling when listening to it?
"Pop"? Well... Give me a moment, please...
I mean, you must've sent the baby Saurians to snatch the record because of the deep spirit of pop within the music, didn't you?
Hang on, please let me explain...
We... never "ordered" the baby Saurians to snatch your record...
They were drawn to your song of their own accord...
Sorry, what?
I mean to say that your songs are outstanding! Believe you me, the baby Saurians crowd around and run about every time I play your music. Never seen them happier!
What? Ugh... But my record...
I know how you feel, having such a precious thing threatened like that...
But look, I'm willing to work as your bodyguard for free, at least until you've released a new record. No one's stealing anything from you as long as I'm around — I guarantee it!
Agh! My records aren't children's songs!
Phew. Thank goodness, it's undamaged...
He must've been trying to lead us that way. Good thing you're so skilled.
You're the ones Mr. Milu Nui asked to pick up the record, right? I've seen you talking to him, so I can guess your purpose.
We're all People of the Springs. That guy... He used to be an alright sort. No clue where he's been getting all these bad habits lately.
Ah yes, I forgot to introduce myself. You can call me Lillo — and again, I apologize for my... compatriot's behavior.
...Bah. I'm no good at formal conversation. If we were back with the tribe, I'd have treated you to a drink of water at least.
Eh, I'm an adventurer. I'm used to this...
Huh, that so? ...Y'know what, judging by your appearance, and how you acquitted yourself back there, you do seem to be an experienced adventurer.
Anyway, never mind that. Let's clean our surroundings up. I'll pack the record so it doesn't get damaged again...
Then I'll go with you to see Mr. Milu Nui. I must apologize to him in person.
You've worked with people from Liyue before?
That's right. I was once hired by a gentleman from Liyue. Accompanied him into the mountains to prospect for ore veins.
I learned a lot from working with him — and when he left, he even gave me a name in his nation's style, "Yiyang."
According to him, it means "to soar elegantly in the air." Not that I really understand where he got that, though...
Ah... My record... It was the original... The original!
I'm very sorry. If there's anything I can do for you, please let me know...
At least that wasn't the only record of yours...
At least your music wasn't lost...
Ah, forget it. And there's no way to restore something this shattered...
Now that it's come to this, I just want to ask you a question...
...When you were listening to my record, did you think it was good?
Not the "it'll be a hit amongst children and baby Saurians" sort of "good," but rather... in the "pop" sense, of having that pop spirit!
Do you get what I mean? Did you get that feeling when listening to it?
"Pop"? Well... Give me a moment, please...
I mean, you must've sent the baby Saurians to snatch the record because of the deep spirit of pop within the music, didn't you?
Hang on, please let me explain...
We... never "ordered" the baby Saurians to snatch your record...
They were drawn to your song of their own accord...
Sorry?
I mean to say that your songs are outstanding! Believe you me, the baby Saurians crowd around and run about every time I play your music. Never seen them happier!
What? Ugh... But my record...

I know how you feel, and I'm very sorry that such an excellent record was destroyed... Look, I'll help you record a new one! No one's stealing anything from you as long as I'm around — I guarantee it!
Agh! My records aren't children's songs!
Did you manage to get my record back?
Why did they snatch it, anyway?
This... Well, it's a long story. I had just come up with a brand-new song. It sings of Spring, animals, and some other things...
But after listening to it, that rascal Pakaa just dumped it straight into the children's section!
He even had the nerve — the nerve! — to tell me how children and baby Saurians alike would adore such interesting, pithy tunes...
Argh, dammit! I'm making real pop music over here! Not kids' songs!
I was so beside myself with fury that I brought my record here, hoping to enjoy the music I'd made myself.
But as I listened, a group of little Koholasaurs came crowding over.
And before I knew it, they came charging in, snatched the record up with their teeth, and made off with it!
I planned to give chase, but before I'd gone far, I discovered a gathering of people... and an angry lot they were, too!
They might've been the ones who, coveting the music I'd made, directed the Koholasaurs to snag my record.
And, and... Aaargh! I've had it with this! Please, good adventurer. I, Milu Nui, am begging you — please, help me get my record back!
I—If you can... Please, try to keep my record as intact as you can. If not... My hard work over the last few days... It will all be in vain...
What exactly makes music "pop," exactly? This is so hard...
Bah. This record isn't anything special, either. Not an element of pop present, not even a "snap"!
Well, it wasn't right anyway, taking the record without consent. You should return it.
Seriously? You really have gone all soft and sentimental after working with that guy from Liyue.
Besides, these don't sell anyway, so aren't I helping him up his sales count?
Hah! The baby Saurians are enjoying it, though! Just look at 'em.
Enough. Give me the record. I'll return it myself.
...You done yet? Or do you wanna fight?
Just in time — My muscles could do with some stretching! Haven't had anything to use as practice lately, y'know?
A brilliant battle, you two! I must say, you left quite the impression!
Not only were you strong, but rhythmic. Why, you commanded that battle as a conductor would, baton in hand! But...
...Alas, the record has been utterly shattered — a dissonant note in an otherwise fabulous performance.
May the Wayob protect those unfortunate friends of mine... But if nothing else, I can bring some of the record back to them.
Anyway, these are for you, so please, take them! Come on, Lillo, let's head back to the tribe.
*sigh* And with any luck, there won't be any fainting from my friends...
Alright, Lillo. See those fellows there? They're our target for the day. Ready?
Still gathering materials?
How are things going with your record?
#My oh my, if it isn't {NICKNAME}? Well, my record's almost ready — thanks to you, Lillo, and those musician friends of mine.
This record combines the sounds of battle, shouts, and all manner of nature sounds... Truly a unique record!
And we also managed to help our musician friends retrieve some of those involuntarily "borrowed" records in the process.
All in all, I'd say that it's all gone rather smoothly thus far, and we've got a good thing going here.
#Ah, yes. We were just about to retrieve another unreturned "borrowed" recording. If you're willing, {NICKNAME}, would you lend us a hand?
Leave it to me.
Thank you! Once I finish this record, I'll make sure your name's first on the acknowledgments list!
And as for you, Lillo... Would the second slot work?
#It would be my honor. Come, {NICKNAME}. Let us go.
Well, I guess this counts as helping you with that record, hmm?
Why of course! Indeed, once I finish this record, I'll make sure your name's first on the acknowledgments list!
